notebooks.title: 同先验RLS：每个前缀与批量解核对

cells.code:
for mode in ['periodic','constant','alternating','burst']:
    X=design(mode); Y=X@theta_true
    for lam in [1.,.9]:
        P=np.eye(2); estimate=np.zeros(2)
        for n,phi in enumerate(X,1):
            gain=P@phi/(lam+phi@P@phi)
            estimate=estimate+gain*(Y[n-1]-phi@estimate)
            P=(P-np.outer(gain,phi)@P)/lam
            weights=lam**np.arange(n-1,-1,-1)
            augmented=np.vstack((lam**(n/2)*np.eye(2), X[:n]*np.sqrt(weights)[:,None]))
            targets=np.r_[np.zeros(2),Y[:n]*np.sqrt(weights)]
            independent=np.linalg.lstsq(augmented,targets,rcond=None)[0]
            assert np.allclose(estimate,independent,atol=1e-10,rtol=0)
        print(mode, 'lambda',lam,'theta64',np.round(estimate,9).tolist())
print('all_prefixes_same_prior_match True')
print('periodic_exact', [.6*32/33,.2*32/33], 'burst_exact',[.6*4/5,.2*4/5])

notebooks.title: 幅值、扰动与预测正确的边界
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
base=np.array([1.,0.,-1.,0.]*16)
previous=np.roll(base,1)
theta_true=np.array([.6,.2])

cells.code:
for amplitude in [1.,.1]:
    X=amplitude*np.column_stack((base,previous))
    disturbance=.01*base
    estimate=np.linalg.lstsq(X,X@theta_true+disturbance,rcond=None)[0]
    gram=X[:8].T@X[:8]
    print('amplitude',amplitude,'min_Gram8',np.linalg.eigvalsh(gram)[0],'condition',np.linalg.cond(X),'theta',np.round(estimate,9).tolist())
    assert np.allclose(estimate,[.6+.01/amplitude,.2],atol=1e-12)
constant=np.ones((8,2)); alternative=np.array([.4,.4])
assert np.allclose(constant@alternative,constant@theta_true)
print('same_constant_prediction True', 'different_parameters', alternative.tolist())
print('weak_amplitude_checks_passed')
